name: saiyandb-playground
description: Playground app for @akashbro/saiyandb using multiple Postgres providers.

scripts.start: npm install && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && npm run db:up && npm run example:basic
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f ./docker-compose.yml up -d primary-db failover-1-db failover-2-db
